caption: The drawing shows a wooden chest of drawers viewed at an angle, with a reddish-brown color and visible wood grain texture. The chest has a total of four horizontal sections: the top section features a drop-front panel with a keyhole at its center, while the three lower sections each contain a drawer with two circular brass or gold-colored knobs and a central keyhole above the knobs. The chest stands on short bracket feet at each corner, and there is a raised, flat panel at the rear edge of the top surface, forming a small backsplash. The background of the drawing is a light beige or cream color, with the edges of the drawing area slightly darker and shaded. The lower left corner includes the name "ARCHIE THOMPSON" in small text.
title: Bishop Hill Square Desk
